alerts.title: FBI Releases 2025 Active Shooter Incidents in the United States Report
alerts.description: The FBI released the 2025 Active Shooter Incidents in the United States report to provide an overview of active shooter incidents and responses to support law enforcement, emergency responders, private organizations, and the public to better understand these threats.

* WHERE...A portion of northwest Arizona, including the following
areas, Hualapai Mountains, Lake Havasu and Fort Mohave, Northwest
Deserts and Northwest Plateau.

* WHEN...From noon MST today through this evening.

* IMPACTS...Excessive runoff may result in flooding of rivers,
creeks, streams, and other low-lying and flood-prone locations.
Flooding may occur in poor drainage and urban areas. Low-water
crossings may be flooded.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- Persistent Storm chances will lead to locally heavy rainfall that
can lead to flash flooding across the watch area
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood You should monitor later forecasts and be prepared to take action
should Flash Flood Warnings be issued.

alerts.title: Flood Watch issued August 12 at 1:11AM MST until August 13 at 12:00AM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Elevated potential for Flash Flooding due to excessive
rainfall.

* WHERE...Yavapai County, Coconino County, Navajo County, Apache
County and northern Gila County.

* WHEN...From Noon MST Wednesday through Midnight MST Wednesday
evening.

* IMPACTS...Flash flooding will be possible in creeks, normally dry
washes, swimming holes, and over recently burned areas. Raging
killer currents will be possible in side canyons and narrow slot
canyons. Low-water crossings may be flooded.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- High moisture values and increased instability will lead to
strong thunderstorms today and this evening.
- Additional information is available at weather.gov/flagstaff. Have a way to receive Flash Flood Warnings and be prepared to take
action should warnings be issued.

alerts.title: JPS Health Network outage persists after at least 8 days
alerts.description: JPS Health Network has been down since at least Monday, Aug. 3. Patients who use MyChart cannot log on to check or schedule appointments or find out about medication refills. People on Facebook have expressed their worries, frustrations, and confusion. JPS initially said that it was experiencing an outage affecting several patient resources, including online serves as well as phone lines and it was working to restore serve ASAP. JPS also apologized for the inconvenience. On Aug. 4, JPS remained under a “controlled network downtime.” The hospital, JPS clinics, and care locations were open and treating patients. alerts.title: Man, woman killed in domestic shooting incident; relationship yet to be revealed
alerts.description: A man and a woman are dead after a fatal shooting that stemmed from a domestic disturbance in Denton on Sunday afternoon. Denton police said the shooting happened around 2:35 p.m. when authorities responded to the 1900 block of N. Bell Avenue after receiving reports of a shooting. First responders found a man and woman with apparent gunshot wounds when they arrived at the scene. Both were declared dead at the scene, officials said. Police said this appears to be an isolated incident with no threat to the public. Officials plan to release the victims’ identities and the relationship between them once their next-of-kin have been notified of their deaths. The shooting investigation is ongoing.

alerts.title: #StopRansomware: Gunra Ransomware
alerts.description: Advisory at a Glance Title #StopRansomware: Gunra Ransomware Original Publication August 10, 2026 Executive Summary Gunra is a ransomware-as-a-service (RaaS) used by affiliates to target government, critical infrastructure, and other organizations. The Gunra ransomware variant first appeared in 2025 and expanded to RaaS operations in 2026. The actors leverage a double-extortion model, both encrypting data and threatening to publish exfiltrated data to a dedicated leak site (DLS) if the ransom is not paid. This advisory provides technical details of the activity, as well as tailored detection and mitigation guidance to protect at-risk organizations from Gunra. alerts.title: Malicious Cyber Actors Targeting Water and Wastewater Sector Internet- Facing Programmable Logic Controllers, Causing Operational Disruptions
alerts.description: The Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) and Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) are issuing this Public Service Announcement (PSA) to warn critical infrastructure asset owners and operators that malicious cyber actors (MCAs) are conducting cyber attacks targeting Operational Technology (OT) devices, including Rockwell Automation/Allen-Bradley Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs), specifically MicroLogix 1100 and 1400 series. Since 27 July 2026, Water and Wastewater Sector (WWS) utility companies in at least seven states have reported incidents to the FBI, and some of that activity degraded water operations. While the FBI has only observed this behavior with the referenced Rockwell PLCs, similar considerations should also be made with other branded PLCs.

alerts.title: Countering Chinese State-Sponsored Actors Compromise of Networks Worldwide to Feed Global Espionage System
alerts.description: Executive summary People’s Republic of China (PRC) state-sponsored cyber threat actors are targeting networks globally, including, but not limited to, telecommunications, government, transportation, lodging, and military infrastructure networks. While these actors focus on large backbone routers of major telecommunications providers, as well as provider edge (PE) and customer edge (CE) routers, they also leverage compromised devices and trusted connections to pivot into other networks. alerts.description: Summary The Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) and U.S. Coast Guard (USCG) are issuing this Cybersecurity Advisory to present findings from a recent CISA and USCG hunt engagement. The purpose of this advisory is to highlight identified cybersecurity issues, thereby informing security defenders in other organizations of potential similar issues and encouraging them to take proactive measures to enhance their cybersecurity posture. This advisory has been coordinated with the organization involved in the hunt engagement. CISA led a proactive hunt engagement at a U.S. critical infrastructure organization with the support of USCG analysts.
